entries.text: Oho... I see we have some new students here with\nus today.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: class_c_01_history_01

entries.text: My name is Raifort. I will be the one to impart\nknowledge of the past to your little minds.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_01_history_02

entries.text: History is a wonderful thing. Truly splendid.\c\nThe lives of our ancestors throughout history\nforged the path to the present in which we live![VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_01_history_03

entries.text: Today, you shall learn about the most mysterious\nlocation in all of Paldea—the Great Crater.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_01_history_04

entries.text: As you are all aware, a massive crater known as\nthe Great Crater of Paldea exists in the heart of\r\nour region.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_01_history_05

entries.text:
The area inside this crater is called Area Zero,
and research of its geological strata and material
composition has shown that the crater is in fact
over one million years old.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_01_history_06

entries.text: It was long believed that [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]a certain something[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]\nrested at the bottom of this mysterious crater.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_01_history_07

entries.text: Aha. Perfect timing to make eye contact, young\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]. Answer me this...[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_01_history_08

entries.text: What exactly was believed to rest in the depths\nof the Great Crater—inside Area Zero?[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_01_history_09

entries.text: Treasure
entries.label: class_c_01_select_01

entries.text: A Snorlax
entries.label: class_c_01_select_02

entries.text: A Pokémon Center
entries.label: class_c_01_select_03

entries.text: Heh. That is correct! You are a surprisingly clever\none, aren’t you? I see you did your homework\r\nprior to coming to my class.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_01_history_answer_01

entries.text: Incorrect! An adorable answer, to be sure, but\nwere you perhaps fooled by my use of “rest”?\r\nThe correct answer is treasure.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_01_history_answer_02

entries.text: Incorrect! An interesting answer, to be sure, but\nthat would be quite the anachronistic artifact.\r\nThe correct answer is treasure.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_01_history_answer_03

entries.text: That’s right! Some believed that a treasure more\nvaluable than anything else in this world rested in\r\nthe depths of the Great Crater![VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_01_history_10

entries.text: So much for dreams of treasure hunting, though,\nas a lab has been built in those very same depths.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_01_history_11

entries.text:
Oh, and before I forget—you would all do well
to remember that the Great Crater and Area
Zero are both off-limits to all but those who
have official business there.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_01_history_12

entries.text:
Do not dare entertain the foolish notion of
gallivanting off to Area Zero in search of riches.\c
It is no place for children dreaming of treasure
and adventure![VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_01_history_13

entries.text: Besides, if it were at all possible to investigate\nthe area, I would surely be the first to do so![VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_01_history_14

entries.text: Oho, is that the time already? I must’ve gotten\nswept up in filling your minds with knowledge.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_01_history_15

entries.text: This ends today’s lesson. We will unravel more of\nhistory’s enigmas together next time.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_01_history_16
